describe: Editing a document as a tree: folders are sections, files are paragraphs or sentences, the label is the text. The Edit case of the Operations design — text is one binding of the general verbs, not a command set of its own.
name: Text editing

vocabulary.describe: Insert a sentence (a file node) under a section at an index
vocabulary.name: insert-sentence

vocabulary.describe: Insert a section (a folder node) under a section or the document root
vocabulary.name: insert-section

vocabulary.describe: Remove a paragraph; a section with paragraphs still in it is refused (fallout: refuse)
vocabulary.name: delete-paragraph

vocabulary.describe: Swap a node's text in place — the address and position do not change
vocabulary.name: replace-word

vocabulary.describe: Reorder a paragraph among its siblings, or move it under another section
vocabulary.name: move-paragraph

vocabulary.describe: Apply a named transform function over a node or the whole document
vocabulary.name: restyle

vocabulary.describe: The edit script that turns one draft into another
vocabulary.name: compare-drafts

vocabulary.describe: Apply a compared difference under this set's bindings
vocabulary.name: merge-drafts
